subject: shiny highcharter Clear all lines with a button?

messages.author: 85e84f25f31bb3f3
messages.subject: shiny highcharter Clear all lines with a button?
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to develop a highchart scatter chart where the number of individual series (i.e., points) are variable and can be selected from one or more groups and add to the plot.  The toy example below achieves this functionality.  I would like to add a clear all option via an action button or some other way but have had no success in developing an approach that works.  Any suggestions appreciated.  

A minimal example is here: 

#
# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.
#
# Find out more about building applications with Shiny here:
#
#    http://shiny.rstudio.com/
#

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)
df <- data.frame(x=1:6, z=7:12, y=c("A", "B","C", "D", "E", "F"))

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- (fluidPage(
  
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Select Inputs"),
  
  # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins 
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("groups", "Pick groups", c("A", "B", "C"),
                  selectize=FALSE, multiple = TRUE),
      selectInput("groups2", "Pick groups", c("D", "E", "F"),
                  selectize=FALSE, multiple = TRUE)


      ##would like to add a button here that would reset plot on click

    ),
    
    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      #tableOutput('table'),
      highchartOutput("hcontainer",height = "500px")#,
      
    )
  )
))

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  firstsub <- reactive({
    subset(df, df$y %in% input$groups)
  })
  
  secondsub <- reactive({
    subset(df, df$y %in% input$groups2)
  })
  
  thirdsub <- reactive({
    rbind(firstsub(), secondsub())
  })
  
  
  #output$table <- renderTable(thirdsub())
  output$hcontainer <- renderHighchart({
    
    unique.tmp <- unique(thirdsub()$y)
    
    TEST1 <- highchart() 
    
    for(i in 1:length(unique.tmp)){
      tmp <- subset(thirdsub(), thirdsub()$y==unique.tmp[i])
      
      TEST <- list.parse2(tmp[,1:2])
      
      TEST1 <-TEST1 %>% 
        hc_add_serie(name=unique.tmp[i], type="scatter", data=TEST) 
    }
    
    TEST1
  })
  
})

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

messages.subject: Re: shiny highcharter Clear all lines with a button?
parts: You can create an action button, then use an observeEvent that calls updateSelectInput twice to clear out those two select boxes. See the article on action buttons on shiny.rstudio.com if you haven't already (I'd send you the link but I'm on my phone).
